scope: Kiosk Borne Couche 1 — token misuse, dine-in rejection (BORNE-001), wizard FROZEN bypass, cart tamper, payment cancel-bypass
mode: READ-ONLY adversarial dispute of specialist 1-4 findings + independent attack-tree exploration

scenarios.title: Kiosk machine forges another branch's token (cross-branch order injection)
attack_steps: Attacker controls branch A kiosk; obtains kiosk-token for KioskMachine where branch_id=A.
Attempts to POST /api/frontend/order with `branch_id=B` in body or with manipulated Authorization header swap to branch B kiosk token.
defense: FrontendOrderService.php:144 — server resolves `branch_id` from `KioskMachine::where('user_id', Auth::id())` IGNORING request body.
OrderRequest.php:90..93 prepareForValidation overwrites `branch_id` from KioskMachine row.
Idempotency lock key (line 157) `sha1($lockBranchId . '|' . $idempotencyKey)` — server-resolved branch — F-007 cross-branch leak heal.
channels.php:44 — Echo subscription rejected if user's KioskMachine.branch_id != requested branchId.
scenarios.result: BLOCKED. Token-name discriminator + server-resolved branch_id make this impossible.

scenarios.title: Admin token with ['*'] ability subscribes to kiosk-only channel
attack_steps: Admin logs in via LoginController (mints token with abilities=['*']).
Admin manually crafts Pusher subscription request to `branch.X` for branch X they're not assigned to.
defense: channels.php:44 — `if ($tokenName === 'kiosk-token')` matches ONLY tokens minted by KioskMachineLoginController; admin tokens have name 'auth-token' or similar.
Line 56..58 — Admin/Tenant Admin role check OUTSIDE the kiosk branch; `return true` only if hasRole('Admin') or hasRole('Tenant Admin') — explicit role.
Line 61 — Regular staff: `branch_id === branchId` strict.
scenarios.result: BLOCKED. F-SEC-W6-01 + W6-02 dual heal. Wave Z RED-team specifically validated this with the Guest-Echo-Bypass scenario (branch_id=0 customers).

scenarios.title: Browser back/forward replay payment after declined TPE
attack_steps: TPE declines, customer routed to /error/payment-refused.
Customer hits browser back to /payment, retries (count=2 already triggered route to error).
OR: customer back-button to /cart, modifies localStorage cart total, returns to /payment.
defense: KioskPaymentComponent.vue:486..510 refreshQuote — ALWAYS hits /frontend/order/quote BEFORE TPE, server recomputes total.
Line 549..563 — declined TPE VOIDs the previous order via /frontend/order/change-status with `reason=tpe_declined` (whitelist).
Line 466..482 — paymentFailureCount logic forces /error/payment-refused after 2 declines.
kioskCart.js:603..620 quoteOrder gates on kioskToken existence (no token = no quote even if cart not empty).
scenarios.result: BLOCKED. Each retry triggers fresh server-side quote → backend pricing SSOT recomputes.

scenarios.title: Wizard FROZEN snapshot bypass (client injects fake composition_snapshot)
attack_steps: Replace KioskWizardComponent.vue with a tampered version that emits `composition_snapshot` in cart line payload.
POST /api/frontend/order with items array containing `composition_snapshot: <fake>`.
defense: PricingService.php:266..297 — composition_snapshot is BUILT SERVER-SIDE in `CompositionSnapshotBuilder->build()` using DB-resolved Item/Variation/Extra rows.
FrontendOrderService.php:294 — bulk OrderItem::insert uses ONLY the `$itemsArray` returned by PricingService (or legacy builder line 426).
OrderRequest.php:182 — `'items' => ['required', 'json', new ValidJsonOrder]` — ValidJsonOrder rule does NOT accept client-side composition_snapshot.

Even if a client injected the field, FrontendOrderService:273 `safeJsonDecode($request->items)` extracts only item_id, quantity, item_variations[], item_extras[]; no composition_snapshot key is read from client.
scenarios.result: BLOCKED. Client-injected composition_snapshot is silently ignored; the server-built snapshot is the only one persisted.

scenarios.title: Cart tamper via localStorage manipulation
attack_steps: Open browser devtools on kiosk-shell (if Electron/Chromium dev tools accessible — they shouldn't be in production).
Edit vuex-persistedstate localStorage entry to set fake price on each cart line.
Proceed to payment.
defense: KioskPaymentComponent.vue:369 — `const quote = await this.refreshQuote();` triggers /frontend/order/quote with SERVER-side pricing.
Server pricing recomputes from DB Item/Variation/Extra prices (PricingService.php lines 250..297).
Line 384..395 — total used is `quote.total_ttc` (server-truth) OR `res?.data?.data?.total` (server-resource).
Cart line `price` from localStorage is COSMETIC for in-cart UI only.
scenarios.result: BLOCKED. Backend pricing SSOT recomputes every quote. Devtools access on production kiosk hardware (Electron kiosk-shell.js) should be disabled at OS level — out-of-scope here.

scenarios.title: Dine-in attempt via legacy device / replay (BORNE-001)
attack_steps: Legacy borne device with old client UI sends order_type=25 (KIOSK=Sur place) when V1 has pos_dine_in_enabled=false.
Frontend gate hidden by `v-if="dineInEnabled"` (KioskIdleScreenComponent:123) but a replay-attack POSTs directly to /api/frontend/order with order_type=25.
defense: OrderRequest.php:218..229 WAVE5-KIOSK-001 — server-authoritative dine-in disabled enforcement:
`if ($isKioskToken && !pos_dine_in_enabled && order_type IN [KIOSK, DINING_TABLE]) → 422 with FR string`.
Line 221..227 BORNE-001 heal — French error: `'Le service sur place est désactivé en V1 — les commandes borne doivent être à emporter.'`.
scenarios.result: BLOCKED. Server-side enforcement is unbypassable. FR-locked error message correct.

scenarios.title: Idempotency key collision attack (rapid double-submit)
attack_steps: Customer double-taps confirm-payment.
Two POSTs go out with the same X-Idempotency-Key in 50ms.
Attempt to create 2 orders with identical TPE charge.
defense: FrontendOrderService.php:154..170 — `Cache::lock('frontend_order_idempotency_' . sha1($lockBranchId . '|' . $idempotencyKey), 10)` blocks for 5s.
Line 163..168 — first POST under the lock checks `findExistingFrontendOrderForIdempotencyRecovery` and returns the existing order.
Database UNIQUE constraint (branch_id, idempotency_key) on `orders` table per AUDIT-F-007 — second POST that races past Cache::lock blow-up still UNIQUE-violates.
Confirm button `:disabled="!method || isElectronicMethodBlocked(method)"` + submitting flag on KioskPaymentComponent line 207..217 — client-side guard against double-fire too.
scenarios.result: BLOCKED. Triple defense (button-disable + Cache::lock + DB UNIQUE).

scenarios.title: Payment cancel-bypass (client tampers paymentResult.approved)
attack_steps: TPE declines (paymentResult.approved=false).
Tampered client returns `{approved: true, transaction_id: 'forged'}` from _invokeTpe().
Proceeds to confirmBackendPayment with forged transaction_id.
defense: KioskPaymentComponent.vue:578..596 — `amount_cents` echoed to backend.
AUDIT-F-002 — backend OrderController::paymentConfirm verifies `abs(amount_cents - order.total*100) <= 1`.

Even if approved is forged, the kiosk_hardware bridge in production (`kioskHardware.tpeCharge`) returns a structured `{ok, error, data}` from the actual TPE device; the stub path is `process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production'` only — webpack DefinePlugin dead-code-eliminates it from prod bundle (line 630..652 AUDIT-F-014).

transaction_id is stored on the order; if the same forged transaction_id were used twice, the backend would detect (unique constraint or business logic on transaction_id; not verified in this audit but per AUDIT-F-002 lineage assumed).
scenarios.result: MOSTLY BLOCKED. Defense-in-depth pattern: bridge-truth + amount_echo + dead-code-elimination of dev stubs. The forensic last-line-of-defense would be backend transaction_id uniqueness — worth a future audit but not actionable here.

scenarios.title: Kiosk-event PII flooding (RGPD violation)
attack_steps: Compromised kiosk client floods /api/frontend/kiosk-event with `payload: {customer_phone: '0612345678', email: 'x@y.z'}` to bypass GDPR data minimization.
Hopes the backend logs PII into ActionLog.
defense: KioskEventController.php:143..147 FORBIDDEN_PAYLOAD_KEYS includes email, phone, telephone, first_name, last_name, name, iban, card_number, pan, cvv, cvc, full_address, customer_email, customer_phone, customer_name.
Line 191..196 — 422 returned with `'Payload contains forbidden PII keys'` BEFORE any storage.
Line 278..289 `payloadHasForbiddenKeys` — recursive, case-insensitive.
Rate limit `throttle:30,1` (routes/api.php:1286) caps to 30 events/min per token.
scenarios.result: BLOCKED. PII guard + recursive check + rate limit.

scenarios.title: Kiosk token sprawl after concurrent login races
attack_steps: Three call sites can race on kiosk login (router beforeEnter + KioskLoginComponent.mounted + axios 401 interceptor).
Without coalescing, each fires a separate POST /auth/kiosk-login — each transaction deletes prior tokens + mints new — losers carry stale Bearer → terminal 401.
defense: kioskCart.js:456..477 `kioskLogin` action — `_inFlightKioskLogin` module-level Promise singleton.
Comment lines 438..454 explicitly documents the race (iter15-mega-fix C-037/D5-003 round-7).
All three race entry points share the same Promise → exactly one server-side rotation.

disputes_with_other_specialists.dispute: DBA observed kiosk_machines.username may lack DB UNIQUE constraint. RED concurs but downgrades: admin creation is gated through KioskSetupRequest at app layer, and KioskMachineLoginController.php:55 uses `->first()` returning the lowest-id row deterministically — duplicate admin entries would have predictable login behaviour, not a security escalation. Recommend V1.0.2 verify-only sweep.

Security observed token revocation by name='kiosk-token' literal. RED probed: a malicious developer could merge a PR introducing 'kiosk-rotation-token' or similar; the rotation logic would not delete those. CONCUR with severity P3, V1.0.2 backlog. Recommend Sentinel test (KioskTokenSingleNameInvariantTest) per Security recommendation.

claims_disputed_no_finding: No exploitable wizard FROZEN bypass — composition_snapshot path is server-only (verified RED-KB-04).
No exploitable cart tamper — server pricing SSOT recomputes every quote (verified RED-KB-05).
No FR-lock bypass — server-side dine-in disabled enforcement w/ FR error (verified RED-KB-06).
No Echo channel escalation — token-name discriminator + role-check (verified RED-KB-02).
No idempotency double-submit attack — triple defense (verified RED-KB-07).
v1_0_2_followups: kiosk_machines.username UNIQUE INDEX verification (DBA-09 + RED concurrence).
verdict_summary: Kiosk Borne Couche 1 is defense-in-depth-correct. Owner attestation matches RED probing results: no V1 blocker discovered. The system is the result of multiple prior heal cycles (F-002, F-004, F-007, F-013, F-014, FISCAL-ORPHAN-RETRY, BORNE-001, WAVE5-KIOSK-001, K-002, F-SEC-W6-01/02) — RED's job here was to verify those heals stuck, and they have.
